Evidence: Neglected infrastructure, systemic poverty, tragic loss.
#Guinea #HumanitarianCrisis

The government claims they are providing medical care and relocation assistance to the victims.

Decades of systemic neglect and ignored evacuation orders created a predictable disaster for the impoverished residents.
